summary: UniClawBench is a 400-task bilingual benchmark for proactive agents in live Docker-based tool, browser, file, and GUI environments. It uses a five-capability taxonomy, a hidden-supervisor/public-user-simulator closed loop, PR/AS metrics, and cross-model/cross-framework experiments to show that current agents often make partial progress but fail to complete real-world tasks reliably.
summary_zh: UniClawBench 论文把主动 Agent 评测从单轮静态答案推进到真实工具、浏览器、文件和 GUI 环境中的闭环任务。它构造 400 个双语任务，每类能力包含 40 个英文和 40 个中文镜像，覆盖 Skill Usage、Exploration、Long-Context Reasoning、Multimodal Understanding 和 Cross-Platform Coordination。方法上，Executor 真正执行任务，Hidden Supervisor 用隐藏 rubric 检查轨迹和产物，Public User Simulator 只接收四字段粗粒度进度信号并生成自然反馈，避免泄露答案或评分规则。实验用 PR 和 AS 同时衡量最终通过率与 checkpoint 进展，自动评测在 50 条轨迹上与 3 名人类专家多数票达到 92.0% 一致，AS 与人工均分相关性为 Pearson r=0.71、Spearman rho=0.68。结果显示最强组合总体 PR 仍低于 50%，Claude Opus-4.8 + OpenClaw 为 0.475，GPT-5.4 + OpenClaw 为 0.407；跨框架比较还显示 OpenClaw、EDICT、Nanobot 的上下文保留、协调摩擦和 token 效率会显著影响结果。局限是 400 个手工任务规模有限，真实环境会漂移，LLM supervisor 仍有偏差，且每个实验组合只跑一次没有误差线。
title: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
